content:
[Intro]
[G7]

[Verse 1]
[Am]I've got a
[Dm]word or two
[A#]To say about
[C]the things that you
[G7]do
[Am]You're telling
[Dm]all those lies
[A#]About the good
[C]things that we can
[G7]have If we close
[Am]our eyes

[Chorus]
[C7]Do what you want to do
And
[G7]go where you're going to
[D#]Think for yourself Cause
[D]I won't be there with you
[G7]

[Verse 2]
[Am]I left you
[Dm]far behind
[A#]The ruins of
[C]the life that you
[G7]have in mind
[Am]And though you
[Dm]still can't see
[A#]I know your mind's
[C]made up You're gon-
[G7]na cause more mi-
[Am]sery

[Chorus]
[C7]Do what you want to do
And
[G7]go where you're going to
[D#]Think for yourself Cause
[D]I won't be there with you
[G7]

[Verse 3]
[Am]Although your
[Dm]mind's opaque
[A#]Try thinking more
[C]if just for your
[G7]own sake
[Am]The future
[Dm]still looks good
[A#]And you've got time
[C]to rectify
[G7]All the things that
[Am]you should

[Chorus]
[C7]Do what you want to do
And
[G7]go where you're going to
[D#]Think for yourself Cause
[D]I won't be there with you
[G7]
[C7]Do what you want to do
And
[G7]go where you're going to
[D#]Think for yourself Cause
[D]I won't be there with you
[C7]
[G7]

[Outro]
[D#]Think for yourself Cause
[D]I won't be there with you
[C7]
[G7]
title: Think For Yourself
tuning: E A D G B E
